layout.arrangement: Two-line bold title centered at top; yellow slide-number badge '33' at top-right; below, one large peach diagram panel with a dark-maroon border fills the rest of the slide. Inside, a left-to-right computational pipeline: input column → yellow W_k boxes with K vectors → gray 'Dot Product' box with blue dots → orchid vertical 'Soft max' bar → column of ⊗ (multiply) circles feeding a blue 'Σ' box → green-dashed output box 'Y₂' at top-center. A parallel value path (V₄..V₁ labels, yellow W_v boxes, second input column) sits on the right; the query path (q₂, yellow W_q box) sits bottom-center-left; the full sentence row (X₁..X₄, X₂ highlighted) runs along the bottom; a dimension legend (1^d · W(d*d) = 1^d, 'd: Embedding Length') sits bottom-right; three yellow pill callouts ('Similarity', 'Probabilities', 'Weighted SUM') form a row above the pipeline.

layout.hierarchy: The two-line bold title is the largest text on the slide. The peach diagram panel dominates the canvas. Within the diagram, visual weight order: (1) the two big colored blocks — taupe 'Dot Product' box and orchid 'Soft max' bar; (2) yellow W boxes and green dashed group containers; (3) the web of red arrows and bold dark-red K/V/q labels; (4) the blue Σ box and thick green output arrow, which form the top-center focal point; (5) small yellow pills; (6) tiny colored vector squares.

visual_elements.description: Key path (left): green dashed rounded container holding 4 rows, each a white box with bold red 'X₁' (subscript tiny) followed by 3 tiny squares (yellow, lavender, pink). To the right, 4 yellow rectangles labeled 'W_k^(1)' [superscript tiny, possibly (1)] with thin orange borders; each emits a 3-square mini vector followed by bold dark-red labels K₄, K₃, K₂, K₁ (top→bottom). Red arrows run from each K vector rightward into the Dot Product box.

'Dot Product' box: tall taupe rectangle; bold dark-red 'Dot Product' at its top; bold dark-red 'K₂q' [?] at its top-right corner; four dark-blue filled dots stacked vertically inside near the right edge; red arrows from the four K vectors and from q₂ (below) converge diagonally onto the dots (arrowheads at the dots, lines crossing); from each dot a red arrow exits right toward the Softmax bar.

'Soft max' bar: tall rounded rectangle, orchid/plum fill, thin dark outline, with 'Soft max' in bold dark red set vertically (rotated 90°). Receives 4 red arrows from the dot-product dots on its left; emits 4 short red arrows to the ⊗ circles on its right.

Weighted-sum stage: four small circles (white fill, red outline) each containing a red asterisk-like multiply symbol '✳', stacked vertically; red horizontal arrows bring the V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ vectors into them from the right (arrowheads at the circles); from each circle a red vertical arrow rises into the Σ box — a wide light-blue rectangle with a heavy dark-blue border containing one large bold dark-blue 'Σ'.

Output: small green dashed rounded box containing 3 tiny squares (green/yellow/gray) and a bold green label 'Y₂'; sits directly above the Σ box; a thick green block arrow points up from the Σ box into it.

Value path (right): bold dark-red labels V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ (top→bottom), each with a 3-square mini vector, followed by four yellow boxes labeled 'W_v^(1)' [superscript tiny]; far right, a green dashed rounded container with 4 rows, each a white box with bold red 'X₁' + 3 colored squares (subscripts tiny; possibly X₁–X₄) [?].

Query path (bottom): bold dark-red 'q₂' with a 3-square mini vector just below the Dot Product box; beneath it a yellow box 'W_q^(1)'; a red arrow runs from the W_q box upward through q₂ into the bottom of the Dot Product box.

Sentence row: wide green dashed rounded container holding four white boxes with bold red 'X₁', 'X₂', 'X₃', 'X₄' (each followed by 3 tiny colored squares); the X₂ box is outlined in magenta (highlight); a chunky red block arrow points up-right at X₂ from below the container.

Dimension legend (bottom-right): green dashed rounded container showing a mini vector labeled '1^d' (red), a white square box with heavy black border containing bold black 'W', a red '=', red 'd*d' beneath W and red '1^d' to the right of the equals sign (i.e., (1×d)·W(d×d)=(1×d)); caption below inside the box, bold dark red: 'd: Embedding Length'.

Green dashed connectors (~1.5pt, arrowheads pointing up): from the left end of the sentence row, running left then up into the bottom of the left X column; from the right end, running right along the bottom (passing behind/into the bottom-right legend area) then up into the bottom of the right X column — indicating both K and V paths read the same sentence inputs.

recreation_brief:

2. Title (text box centered, x 15-85%, y 4-17%, Arial bold ~20pt, centered): line 1 = 'Self Attention Mechanism ' in black + '(Linear Transformation of Inputs)' in blue #0000CC; line 2 = '(Self Attention of word X₂ w.r.t All words in Sentence ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ )' in black with 'X₂' and 'X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄' in bold red #CC0000 (apply subscript formatting to the numerals; keep the unbalanced parentheses exactly as written).
3. Slide number: oval at x≈90%, y≈10%, ~0.45in diameter; fill #FFFF00, 1.5pt black outline, bold black '33' centered.
4. Left input column: rounded rectangle x 6-15%, y 41-73%; fill #EAF6EA, 1.5pt dashed green #00A651 border. Inside, 4 stacked rows; each row = white box (thin gray border) containing bold red 'X₁' (subscript) + three 0.12in squares colored #EDE28A, #C9A8E0, #F2B8C6.

6. Dot Product box: rectangle x 26-36%, y 33-73%, fill #B3AAA4; bold dark-red 'Dot Product' at top center; bold dark-red 'K₂q' at its top-right corner. Place 4 dark-blue #003366 dots (0.12in circles) stacked near its right edge. Draw red #CC0000 1pt arrows from each K vector and from q₂ converging diagonally onto the dots (arrowheads at the dots, lines crossing).
7. Query path: below the box place bold dark-red 'q₂' + 3 colored squares; beneath that a yellow box 'W_q^(1)'; red arrow from the W_q box up through q₂ into the Dot Product box bottom.
8. Softmax bar: rounded rectangle x 47-52%, y 35-73%, fill #E7C1E7, thin maroon outline; vertical text 'Soft max' in bold dark red (rotate 90°). Four red arrows from the blue dots to its left edge; four short red arrows from its right edge to the ⊗ circles.

Red horizontal arrows from the V vectors pointing left into the circles' right sides. Σ box: rectangle x 53-68%, y 35-41%, fill #CCE4F7, 2pt dark-blue #003366 border, one large bold dark-blue 'Σ' centered.
10. Output: above Σ, a small dashed green rounded box (x 56-64%, y 21-27%) containing 3 tiny squares (green/yellow/gray) and bold green 'Y₂'. Add a thick green #00A651 block arrow from the Σ box top pointing up into it.

13. Legend bottom-right: dashed green rounded container x 76-93%, y 85-98%: mini vector squares labeled '1^d' (red), white box with 2pt black border and bold black 'W', red '=', red 'd*d' beneath W and red '1^d' to the right; below, bold dark-red 'd: Embedding Length'.
